findings.issue: «hizo … como que mandó» is the Spanish idiom of pretending or acting as if. כַּאֲשֶׁר with וַיַּעַשׂ and צִוָּה licenses that Moses did as Jehovah commanded, not a simulated or counterfactual command.

notes: The rest of the verse matches the tokens: Moisés, Jehová, subieron, Hor el monte, a ojos de toda la congregación.
